title: Materials Corrosion Toolkit 0.1.0a1
description: Research-alpha Python toolkit for modular materials, corrosion, electrochemistry, transport, structural integrity, fatigue, fabrication, inspection and evidence-based integration. The distribution is materials-corrosion-toolkit and the Python namespace remains matintegrity. The release includes explicit input contracts, declared output units, API documentation, authored mathematical checks, development history and reproducibility guidance. Registered API counts include data and workflow contracts; they are not counts of independently validated physical solvers. Known quality and external-evidence limitations are documented. No field-accuracy, standard-compliance or safety certification is claimed.
